title: Distributional Lifting for Discrete Optimization
summary: We introduce a framework that transforms discrete optimization into continuous optimization over parameterized probability distributions. The framework reveals a common distributional structure behind several methods that have largely developed independently, including continuous reformulations for multilinear binary optimization, Markov decision processes and reinforcement learning, the cross-entropy method, mean-field variational optimization, and the quantum approximate optimization algorithm.
